# Omnivy

> Omnivy is a browser clipper for Obsidian, Notion, Google Drive, OneDrive, and Dropbox.

## Core pages
- /
- /install
- /documentation
- /future-improvements
- /feedback
- /developer

## What Omnivy does
- Captures articles, selections, and bookmarks from the web.
- Clips into local Obsidian vaults or connected cloud providers.
- Supports connected accounts for Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, and Notion.
- Provides a public roadmap and feedback flow for feature requests and bug reports.

## Machine-readable resources
- /sitemap.xml
- /robots.txt

## Content summary
- Home page: product overview, integrations, and setup flow.
- Install page: Chrome Web Store listing and installation CTA.
- Documentation: setup and usage guide.
- Future improvements: roadmap plus current GitHub requests.
- Feedback: feature requests and bug reports submission form.
